jobs.description:
Who we are 
 

OTIV is a Ghent-based company leading the autonomous revolution in rail. We are on a mission to increase safety and efficiency of railway operations by teaching rail vehicles to drive autonomously. By making trains more efficient and safer, we actively contribute to a modal shift and a greener future. We bring this vision to life by a unique focus on the most challenging environments such as cities, shunting yards and industrial sites. Thanks to high-profile partners and world-leading clients such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF Group, ArcelorMittal and CAF we deliver the future of railway operations today.
 

 
 

OTIV is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic. OTIV strives to create an environment in which all employees feel confident in their ability to bring their authentic selves to work and secure collaborating with colleagues and customers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Als 
Finance & Admin Specialist neem je ownership over de financiële administratie van OTIV: facturatie, procure-to-pay en ondersteuning bij onze maandelijkse, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen. Naast de cijfers breng je energie en structuur naar onze administratieve backbone: je houdt processen draaiende en mensen ondersteund. Je vormt een sterk team met Marthe (Admin Specialist met focus op People & Operations).
 

Ben jij iemand die detailgericht en samenwerkingsgericht is, onze bedrijfsprocessen met overtuiging wil opnemen, en zowel houdt van de nauwkeurigheid van finance als van de variatie die we te bieden hebben? Apply now!
 

 
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 

As Finance & Admin Specialist at OTIV you will
 

Finance (50%)
 
 

• Book incoming and outgoing invoices and ensure accurate processing 

• Manage the full PO-to-invoice flow 

• Support monthly, quarterly and annual closings together with the accountant 

• Assist in reporting actuals, budget and forecast, and follow up department and company budget 

• Handle payment processing, expenses and record-keeping 

• Administer company insurance matters  

Procurement & logistics
 
 

• Run the full procure-to-pay process: sourcing, receiving, invoicing 

• Place orders with suppliers and follow up to ensure on-time delivery 

• Take ownership of shipments (domestic and international) 

• Maintain accurate records in Odoo, including stock management  

Office & compliance
 
 

• Manage e-inboxes and handle incoming requests 

• Manage client site access, clearances and documentation 

• Administer office onboarding, car park, and PPE 

• Support ISO 9001 processes and audit documentation 

• Provide general administrative support and help coordinate events  

Furthermore, you will form a strong administrative team with Marthe (Admin Specialist with a focus on People & Operations).

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor in accountancy or finance (or equivalent through experience) 

• 3+ years in a financial-administrative role 

• Confident with the numbers: closings, budget follow-up, procure-to-pay, invoicing 

• Hands-on with Odoo or comparable ERP and strong in Excel 

• Genuine passion for office management and general operations: you like keeping things running and people supported 

• Structured, accurate, and able to own end-to-end processes 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• Proactive and pragmatic, thrives in a fast-moving scale-up 

• Affinity with compliance and process improvement 

• Curious about AI and automation: you actively look for ways to streamline and automate administrative and finance processes  

• Fluent in Dutch & English (other languages are a plus)  

Nice to have:
 
 

• Previous experience in a fast-paced & broad administrative team, ideally in a tech or scale-up environment. 

• Experience in international shipping (export documentation,...) 

• Experience in People/HR processes (payroll, ...)

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.
Languages

• Good command of English and French.
• Dutch is an advantage but is not required. 
What We Offer

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.
• A young, international and supportive team.
• A varied role with a high level of autonomy.
• Competitive salary based on experience, plus additional benefits.

Guide them through sales process, including financing, trade-ins and delivery expectations, each one as an opportunity to re-ignite passion for Tesla

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Manager (M/W/D) B2B / Life Science Division (Kaufmann/-frau - Marketingkommunikation)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Pharma / Biopharma Industry

Your Responsibilities:

● Performance & Web: End-to-end management and optimization of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO (WordPress).

● Lead Pipeline: Structured qualification and handoff of marketing leads to our international sales team.

● Content: Creation of white papers, case studies, and web content tailored for B2B decision-makers.

● Budget & ROI: Ongoing monitoring and tracking of all campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experience: At least 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B digital marketing—preferably within an industrial, technical, or life sciences background.

● Tech Stack: Demonstrated proficiency with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, WordPress, and CRM platforms.

● Mindset: Strong technical aptitude to translate complex concepts into high-impact content.

● Languages: Native or full professional fluency in English (primary working language) alongside strong business-level German.

● Project Management: Proven ability to manage budgets, meet complex deadlines, and execute international trade show projects seamlessly.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

1 SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER Your contribution will be
 * Facilitating project delivery by leading core teams and applying and adjusting established frameworks to ensure seamless execution of complex or multi-project initiatives with cross-team alignment
 * Overseeing medium-sized project budgets and spend, applying these skills to manage complex budgets, including high-value external supplier contracts
 * Managing risks, dependencies and issues through early identification, escalation and mitigation, applying capabilities to anticipate systemic risks and shape organisation-wide responses

 * Reporting progress by tracking deliverables and providing timely updates, integrating this with insights on trends, risks and performance for leadership decisions

Your profile ideally illustrates
 * Several years of experience in project management roles, ideally in the non-profit sector. Delivering high-complexity projects involving multiple entities, cross-functional teams, large budgets, external partners and contracts, rapid decision-making, and strategic oversight
 * Practitioner-level certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile Practitioner, or Scrum Master
 * Fluency in English is essential, with additional languages considered a strong asset for international collaboration
 * Proficient in MS Office and project management software, such as MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools
 * Strong collaboration, problem-solving, and confident leadership mindset
 * Passion for animal welfare and FOUR PAWS vision and mission

Our offer includes
 * The opportunity to truly contribute to global animal welfare
 * A multinational team
 * Flexible working times with the option of partial remote work
 * A dog-friendly workplace with a dynamic and pleasant work environment
 * Workplace health and wellbeing initiatives
 * Wiener Linien annual ticket (or partial contribution to Klima Ticket) and pension fund after probationary period
 * PAWSdays: extra days off at the end of the year on top of your 25 days of annual leave
 * Birthday leave: extra day off to use around your birthday
 * A one-year fixed-term contract
 * The minimum gross annual salary for this position starts at 55,000 EUR (full-time base, consisting of 14 payments), in accordance with our internal compensation scheme
 

At FOUR PAWS we stand up for animal welfare worldwide by empowering everyone to contribute their unique and authentic experiences and to show compassion for animals, people, and the planet. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a workplace built on equity, inclusion, and belonging. Role Purpose

At Kapsch TrafficCom, we are shaping the future of intelligent mobility and transportation solutions. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and test high-quality embedded software, translating customer and product requirements into reliable, scalable platform capabilities that support next-generation V2X and GNSS technologies.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Design, develop, and validate embedded V2X and GNSS software and supporting development tools.
 * Implement high-quality, maintainable, and reusable code following best practices for embedded systems.
 * Collaborate with product management and design teams to translate user needs and product requirements into scalable platform capabilities.
 * Contribute to system design discussions, ensuring robust, efficient, and extensible solutions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

 * A technical degree, preferably a master degree in systems engineering, software architecture, computer science, information technology, or a related field.
 * 5+ years of professional experience in embedded software development and Linux based applications.
 * Expert-level proficiency in C and C++ is required; knowledge of IBM Rational Rhapsody is a plus.
 * Familiarity with application interfaces for communication protocols, particularly V2X, GNSS, 3G/4G, TCP/IP, BT and LWM2M, is desirable.
 * Proven experience in developing testable code, implementing automated unit tests, and working with automated test environments.
 * A proactive approach, strong teamwork skills, and effective communication abilities.
 * Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Docker is advantageous, as is familiarity with Kibana and Grafana.
 * Business-fluent English is essential; German language skills are an asset.
 * Familiarity with agile development processes.

1 Werkstudent:in Sales (m/w/d) Why This Role Exists
Right now the founders + the Founders Associate make the cold calls themselves. That works, but it does not scale.

Since we see positive response rates from our current outreach efforts, we are now building a proper outbound motion, and you're the person who runs the front of it. Not "support sales". You dial, you book, you own the number.

The upside for you: cold calling is a skill you can only learn by volume. Doing it +200 times a week for six months will teach you more about business than any course you could sign up for.

Your Role
Week 1 to 4: Get on the phone

 * Shadow the founders on live calls, then take over your own call blocks
 * Learn the pitch, the finance language and the three objections that come up every single time
 * 60 to 80 dials per call block, roughly 200 per week
 * Book your first qualified meeting

Month 2 to 3: Own your pipeline

 * Build and clean your own target lists (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay)
 * Research accounts before you dial, so the opener actually lands (or automate it)
 * Handle the full top of funnel: dial, qualify, book, hand over
 * Keep the CRM clean enough that we can actually read it

Month 4 and beyond: Build the machine

 * Test openers, lists and follow-up sequences, and tell us what works
 * Turn what works into a playbook the next hire can use
 * Grow into full-cycle sales, sit in on discovery and demo calls, take your own deals

What You Need to Bring
Non-negotiables:

 * German really well, solid English. Austrian and German CFOs will not do a discovery call in English.
 * You are not scared of the phone. Ten rejections in a row annoy you, they don't break you.
 * We don't care what you studied, or whether you studied at all. University, gap year, or straight out of HAK all work. How you talk matters more than what's on your certificate.
 * 20 h/week, on site in Vienna. Cold calling is a team sport and you learn it fastest sitting next to someone who's already good at it.
 * High agency. You see what needs to happen and make it happen.

Strong plus:

 * Any job where you've had to talk to strangers and sell something: promotion, fundraising, retail, call center, student org
 * Finance or accounting background, or genuine curiosity about how a controlling team actually works
 * You've used Apollo, HubSpot, Attio, lemlist or similar before
 * You use the latest AI tools to automate annoying manual work and follow-ups

What You'll Get
Compensation:

 * 20 h/week to start. If it works for both sides, more hours or a full-time contract are possible later.
 * You earn the same whether the week went well or badly. In your first months you should be learning to call properly, not chasing a number to make rent
 * Minimum salary: €2,236 gross per month (full-time, 38.5 h/week, paid 14 times a year) according to the Austrian collective agreement, with overpayment based on qualifications and experience.

Learning:

 * Direct coaching from founders who've sold to enterprise CFOs and built B2B companies before
 * Weekly call reviews on your own recordings. This is where the actual learning happens.
 * You'll speak with C-level executives at companies with 100 to 5,000 employees, in your first month
 * You learn the full outbound stack: ICP, list building, enrichment, sequencing, calling, qualification

Growth:

 * Clear path from top-of-funnel to full-cycle sales, at the speed you earn it
 * First in line for the first full-time sales role as we scale
 * A skill set that makes you employable at any startup in Europe, or lets you build your own

How to Apply
Send an email to founders@northscope.at and include one short paragraph:

 * Why you want to spend 20 hours a week calling strangers about accounting software
